statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the single line item 'Depreciation and amortization' in the operating activities section of the cash flow statement. The supplementary tables provide details on operating lease assets and liabilities, but the depreciation/amortization expense related to those leases is already included in the consolidated 'Depreciation and amortization' figure. No other elements from the statement need to be combined to make up this field.
